meanings.english: to give part of something to others
meanings.example: She shared a useful study tip with me.

meanings.english: one part of something that is divided among people
meanings.example: Everyone paid an equal share of the cost.
meanings.translation: 每个人都支付了同等份额的费用。

synonyms.difference: share 在 “share an idea” 中是本卡需要主动掌握的表达；distribute 含义接近，但宾语、语气和固定搭配不一定相同。

antonyms.usage: 和 share 的核心义形成对比；先在真实句子中判断是否确实构成反向关系。
